# ecdata attribution and source pin

The upstream data source is **Elliptic Curve Data (`ecdata`)** by
**J. E. Cremona**:

- Repository: https://github.com/JohnCremona/ecdata
- Pinned commit: `25cec5ecfec8b9f016eb1631ac633194c2bed39f`
- Upstream release reference: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.161341
- Format documentation: https://johncremona.github.io/ecdata/
- Upstream license: **The Artistic License 2.0**.

`LICENSE` and `README.upstream.md` preserve the exact upstream bytes at that
commit. Their source URLs and fingerprints are in
`../../provenance/ECDATA_LICENSE_PROVENANCE.json`. The five exact source input
files are listed in `SOURCE_FILES_SHA256.json`. They are obtained by the
repository's hash-verifying fetch helper or from the canonical V0.2 archive.

Those inputs are unchanged upstream data, distinct from the study's calculations
and original writing. Their upstream terms remain in force. Include this notice
and the unchanged upstream license with distributions of the source input files,
including when the original canonical ZIP is distributed with a companion.

The copyright notice for The Perl Foundation in the upstream license concerns
the license document; it is not an attribution of the elliptic-curve data to
that organization. No endorsement by the upstream author is asserted.
